title: Length of a nested pair encoding
statement: Let $d$ be a data object with parameters $C_1,c_1,C_2,c_2$, and let $x,u,v$ be finite bit strings. Suppose $|u|=C_1(|x|+1)^{c_1}$ and $|v|=C_2(|\langle x,u\rangle|+1)^{c_2}$, where $\langle x,u\rangle$ is the encoding that doubles each bit of $x$, appends the separator $01$, and then appends $u$. Then $|\langle\langle x,u\rangle,v\rangle|=2\bigl(2|x|+2+C_1(|x|+1)^{c_1}\bigr)+2+C_2\bigl(2|x|+2+C_1(|x|+1)^{c_1}+1\bigr)^{c_2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a data object, with parameters $C_1,c_1,C_2,c_2$
